title: A Symbiotic Bond
description: A larval spotted salamander (Ambystoma maculatum) sits inside a gelatinous egg, found in a small woodland pond in Boone County, Arkansas. The egg mass contains algae, which provides oxygen and carbohydrates to the developing salamander, while also consuming its waste products. Photographer Isaac Szabo captured this image without disturbing the larvae’s habitat by laying on a paddleboard and lowering a camera into the pond.
translated_description: 一只斑点钝口螈（Ambystoma maculatum）的幼虫正栖身于凝胶状的卵囊中，该卵囊发现于阿肯色州布恩县一处小型林地池塘。卵块内含有藻类，这些藻类为发育中的蝾螈提供氧气和碳水化合物，同时消耗其排泄物。摄影师艾萨克·萨博（Isaac Szabo）通过趴在桨板上将相机沉入池塘的方式拍摄了这张照片，全程未干扰幼虫的栖息环境。
